sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报 DealBook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the events of June 7th, 2016.
sentences.zh: 今天，回顾2016年6月7日发生的事件。

sentences.en: Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: sends an email, and Donald Trump gives a speech.
sentences.zh: 发送了一封电子邮件，而唐纳德·特朗普发表了一场演讲。

sentences.en: And a group of international scientists are devising a plan to send messages into space to see if we're alone.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一群国际科学家正在制定一项计划，向太空发送信息，看看我们是否孤独。

sentences.en: But what if we're not?
sentences.zh: 但如果我们并不孤独呢？

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月14日，星期五。

sentences.en: Peter Baker, what did Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克，小唐纳德·特朗普在

sentences.en: do in the late afternoon of June 7th, 2016?
sentences.zh: 2016年6月7日傍晚做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, just after six o'clock in the evening, in fact, he hit the send button on an email
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上就在傍晚六点刚过，他点击了发送键，发出一封电子邮件，

sentences.en: confirming what we now, of course, consider a pretty famous meeting with a Russian lawyer who was supposed to be bringing him and criminating information about Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 确认了我们现在当然认为那是一次非常著名的会面，对方是一位俄罗斯律师，据称要带给他关于希拉里·克林顿的负面信息。

sentences.en: And Peter, can you read us the relevant line from Don Jr.'s email exchange?
sentences.zh: 彼得，你能为我们读一下小唐纳德·特朗普邮件往来中相关的那一行吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, Ron Goldstone, the intermediary setting up this meeting, told Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 嗯，安排这次会面的中间人罗恩·戈德斯通告诉小唐纳德，

sentences.en: that the Russian government lawyer would provide, quote, some official documents and information that would
sentences.zh: 那位俄罗斯政府律师将提供，引用原文，“一些官方文件和信息，这些信息将

sentences.en: incriminate Hillary and her dealings with Russia and would be very useful to your father.
sentences.zh: 指控希拉里及其与俄罗斯的交易，这对你父亲非常有用。”

sentences.en: He goes on to say this is, quote, obviously very high level and sensitive information, but as part of Russia and its government support for Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，这，引用原文，“显然是非常高级别和敏感的信息，但这是俄罗斯及其政府支持特朗普先生的一部分。”

sentences.en: And several hours later, same day, the evening of June 7th, what happened with Don Jr.'s father,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，同一天，即6月7日晚上，小唐纳德的父亲，

sentences.en: Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, just three hours later, he takes the stage at his Westminster club in New York to claim victory
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在三小时后，他在纽约的威斯敏斯特俱乐部登台，宣布在

sentences.en: in the final Republican presidential primary that are going to give him the nomination.
sentences.zh: 共和党总统初选中获胜，这将使他获得提名。

sentences.en: But he's already thinking ahead to the general election.
sentences.zh: 但他已经在考虑大选了。

sentences.en: And in his speech, Donald Trump Sr.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，唐纳德·特朗普老先生

sentences.en: says, I am going to give a major speech on probably Monday of next week, and we're going to be discussing all of the things that have taken place with the Clintons.
sentences.zh: 说：“我打算在下周一左右发表一次重要演讲，我们将讨论所有关于克林顿夫妇的事情。”

sentences.en: I think you're going to find it very informative and very, very interesting.
sentences.zh: 我想你会发现它非常有信息量，而且非常、非常有趣。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton, he said, turned the State Department into her private hedge fund.
sentences.zh: 他说，希拉里·克林顿把国务院变成了她的私人对冲基金。

sentences.en: The Russians, the Saudis, the Chinese all gave money to Bill and Hillary and got favorable treatment in return.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人、沙特人、中国人都给了比尔和希拉里钱，并以此换取了优待。

sentences.en: So, Peter, Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 所以，彼得，小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: is on this day confirming a meeting in which he's been promised official documents that would incriminate Hillary and her dealings with Russia and, quote,
sentences.zh: 在这一天确认了一次会面，他被承诺会得到能指控希拉里及其与俄罗斯交易的官方文件，并且引用原文，

sentences.en: be very useful to your father.
sentences.zh: “对你父亲非常有用”。

sentences.en: And just hours later, his father, Donald Trump, promises supporters that he will soon reveal Hillary Clinton's corrupt dealings with foreign governments,
sentences.zh: 而仅仅几小时后，他的父亲唐纳德·特朗普向支持者承诺，他很快就会揭露希拉里·克林顿与外国政府的腐败交易，

sentences.en: including, quote, the Russians.
sentences.zh: 包括，引用原文，“俄罗斯人”。

sentences.en: Do I have that right?
sentences.zh: 我理解得对吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And obviously, this is an extraordinary coincidence, if it's that.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果这算巧合的话，那这是一个非同寻常的巧合。

sentences.en: Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: said he never told his father about this meeting.
sentences.zh: 说他从未告诉过他父亲关于这次会面的事。

sentences.en: And the president said this week that he didn't know about it until a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 总统本周也表示，他直到几天前才知道这件事。

sentences.en: But the timing obviously does lend itself to a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 但这个时间点显然引发了许多疑问。

sentences.en: It seems very extraordinary to happen that quickly.
sentences.zh: 发生得如此之快，看起来非常不寻常。

sentences.en: Now, look, politics is full of coincidences that look like conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 听着，政治充满了看起来像阴谋的巧合。

sentences.en: We shouldn't make any assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该做任何假设。

sentences.en: But clearly, this will be a day that investigators will look at a little bit more closely in the future.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这将是调查人员未来会更仔细审视的一天。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: With the idea in mind that potentially Donald Trump Jr., this son who works in the same
sentences.zh: 考虑到小唐纳德·特朗普，这个与他父亲在同一栋

sentences.en: building as his father and is an informal advisor on the campaign, potentially could have informed his
sentences.zh: 大楼工作且担任竞选非正式顾问的儿子，有可能已经通知了他

sentences.en: father of this upcoming meeting and its promise of information about Russia and Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 父亲关于这次即将到来的会面及其关于俄罗斯和希拉里·克林顿的信息承诺。

sentences.en: Well, that's what people would suspect, actually, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是人们会怀疑的，对吧？

sentences.en: The sequence of events certainly lends itself to that interpretation.
sentences.zh: 这一系列事件确实容易让人产生这种解读。

sentences.en: Of course, the two people involved both say, no, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 当然，涉及的两人都说，不，那不是真的。

sentences.en: That didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 那没有发生。

sentences.en: And what the president's aides say is, look, what he was talking about that night was something we had planned for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 总统的助手们说的是，看，他那天晚上谈论的是我们早就计划好的事情。

sentences.en: We always knew we were going to pivot to the general election that night.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都知道那天晚上要转向大选。

sentences.en: That's the last night of the Republican primaries.
sentences.zh: 那是共和党初选的最后一晚。

sentences.en: And we had this information from this book that had come out a year earlier called Clinton Cash by a conservative author who
sentences.zh: 我们有来自一年前出版的一本书的信息，书名叫《克林顿现金》，作者是一位保守派作家，他

sentences.en: had talked about various things she had done as Secretary of State that seemed to raise questions
sentences.zh: 谈到了她担任国务卿期间所做的各种似乎引发了关于

sentences.en: about propriety, including actions with Russia, particularly the approval by the State Department
sentences.zh: 正当性质疑的事情，包括与俄罗斯的行动，特别是国务院批准

sentences.en: of a deal that permitted a Canadian company to secure uranium in the former Soviet regions.
sentences.zh: 了一项允许一家加拿大公司在前苏联地区获得铀矿的交易。

sentences.en: So there is another explanation there.
sentences.zh: 所以那里有另一种解释。

sentences.en: But again, you know, the timing does lend itself to questions.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，你知道，这个时间点确实引发了疑问。

sentences.en: So to that point, to your knowledge, Peter, had President Trump said anything like that before,
sentences.zh: 那么说到这一点，据你所知，彼得，特朗普总统之前说过类似的话吗，

sentences.en: that he said the night of June 7th in New York to these supporters, suggesting that Hillary Clinton had corrupt dealings with Russia?
sentences.zh: 就是他在6月7日晚上在纽约对支持者说的那样，暗示希拉里·克林顿与俄罗斯有腐败交易？

sentences.en: Or was this brand new?
sentences.zh: 还是这是全新的？

sentences.en: Whether he's mentioned it in the past, this is the beginning of a new stage in his campaign where he's really focusing his fire on Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 无论他过去是否提到过，这都是他竞选活动新阶段的开始，他真正将火力集中在希拉里·克林顿身上。

sentences.en: And this is a theme he's going to return to again and again in the weeks and months to come.
sentences.zh: 这是他在未来几周和几个月里会反复提到的主题。

sentences.en: He ultimately doesn't even deliver the speech on the following Monday, as he promised, they say, because it ended up coming a day after that terrible
sentences.zh: 他最终甚至没有像承诺的那样在接下来的周一发表那次演讲，他们说，因为那恰好是在那场可怕的

sentences.en: shooting in Orlando that killed so many people and it felt inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 奥兰多枪击案发生后的一天，那次枪击案造成了那么多人死亡，感觉不合适。

sentences.en: He didn't come back to it, though, a week or so later.
sentences.zh: 不过，大约一周后，他又回到了这个话题。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton's State Department approved the transfer of 20 percent of America's uranium holdings to Russia.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿的国务院批准将美国20%的铀储备转移给俄罗斯。

sentences.en: So we have this third key figure here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们这里有第三个关键人物。

sentences.en: What is Hillary Clinton doing around this time?
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿这段时间在做什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's the interesting thing, too, right?
sentences.zh: 这也是有趣的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: She had also begun attacking Donald Trump for being too close with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 她也开始攻击唐纳德·特朗普与弗拉基米尔·普京走得太近。

sentences.en: And he said if he were grading
sentences.zh: 他说如果他要给

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin as a leader, he'd give him an A.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京作为领导人打分，他会给他打A。

sentences.en: Now, I will leave it to the psychiatrist to explain his affection for tyrants.
sentences.zh: 现在，我会留给精神病学家来解释他对暴君的这种喜爱。

sentences.en: Just a few days before all this, in fact, the day before Goldstone sent his very first email, she gives a speech in which she says that if you don't know exactly who you're
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在这一切发生的前几天，也就是戈德斯通发出第一封电子邮件的前一天，她发表了一次演讲，她说如果你不知道你到底在

sentences.en: dealing with, men like Putin will eat your lunch.
sentences.zh: 和谁打交道，像普京这样的人会把你吃得连骨头都不剩。

sentences.en: So you can see the continuation of all these events in the same time period really looks a little different today now that we've seen these emails.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到，在同一时期，所有这些事件的延续，在今天看来，既然我们已经看到了这些电子邮件，确实看起来有点不同了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Hey, thanks.
sentences.zh: 嘿，谢谢。

sentences.en: Good talking to you as always.
sentences.zh: 和你聊天总是很愉快。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于对设计的热爱以及围绕它的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，然后你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个像活生生的、快闪式的博物馆，里面摆满了美丽的50年历史的文物。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼表出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: For decades, scientists have been scanning the skies for any evidence of intelligent life beyond Earth.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，科学家们一直在扫描天空，寻找地球以外存在智慧生命的任何证据。

sentences.en: There's been this long tradition of listening to the cosmos, effectively, for signs of intelligent life.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，人们一直有一种倾听宇宙的传统，实际上是为了寻找智慧生命的迹象。

sentences.en: Structured radio waves, it might be some kind of signal that we could pick up.
sentences.zh: 结构化的无线电波，那可能就是我们可以接收到的某种信号。

sentences.en: But this is what they call sometimes passive in the sense that all you're doing is listening to signals that are out there.
sentences.zh: 但这有时被称为被动，因为你所做的只是倾听外面的信号。

sentences.en: You're not sending anything.
sentences.zh: 你什么都没发送。

sentences.en: Steven Johnson is reporting on a new group of scientists who call themselves METI.
sentences.zh: 史蒂文·约翰逊正在报道一群称自己为METI的新科学家。

sentences.en: Messaging extraterrestrial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 即“发送地外智慧信息”。

sentences.en: They want to take a more active role and actually initiate conversation.
sentences.zh: 他们想发挥更积极的作用，真正发起对话。

sentences.en: So, Steven, tell me about the scientists at this organization, METI.
sentences.zh: 那么，史蒂文，跟我说说METI这个组织的科学家们吧。

sentences.en: So, I'm in the middle of writing a book about long-term decision making.
sentences.zh: 我正在写一本关于长期决策的书。

sentences.en: And I gave a talk in
sentences.zh: 我在一月份的

sentences.en: San Francisco in January, the Long Now Foundation.
sentences.zh: 旧金山“长期当下”基金会上做了一次演讲。

sentences.en: And afterwards, Alexander Rose, who runs Long Now, came up and said, listen, you're interested in long-term decisions.
sentences.zh: 之后，负责“长期当下”的亚历山大·罗斯走过来对我说，听着，你对长期决策感兴趣。

sentences.en: I'm helping to advise this organization called METI that is working on this plan to send active messages targeted at planets that might support life.
sentences.zh: 我正在帮助建议一个叫METI的组织，他们正在制定一项计划，向可能支持生命的行星发送主动信息。

sentences.en: And if you think about it, given the timescales involved in the kind of transmission time targeting a planet that might be a thousand light years away or 25,000 light years
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，考虑到传输时间所涉及的时间尺度，瞄准一颗可能在1000光年或25000光年之外的行星，

sentences.en: away, you could decide to send a message and not get a reply for 50,000 years, potentially.
sentences.zh: 你可能决定发送一条信息，而5万年内都收不到回复，这很有可能。

sentences.en: And he was like, that is about as long-term a decision as you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 他说，这大概是你所能想象的最长期的决策了。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, it's hard to think up another choice that you could make, you know, in 2017, where the results of that choice wouldn't come back to you for 50,000 years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，很难想出另一个你可以在2017年做出的选择，而那个选择的结果要到5万年后才会回到你身边。

sentences.en: It's just hard to do that.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难做到。

sentences.en: And so, he introduced me to this guy, Doug Bakush, who started this organization, METI.
sentences.zh: 所以，他把我介绍给了道格·巴库什，他创办了这个组织，METI。

sentences.en: And the more I dug into it, the more fascinated I got.
sentences.zh: 我挖掘得越深，就越着迷。

sentences.en: Hey, is this Doug?
sentences.zh: 嘿，是道格吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，是我。

sentences.en: Hey, Doug, it's Michael Barbaro from The Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，道格，我是《时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Very well.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: And your name is pronounced Vakoch?
sentences.zh: 你的名字发音是Vakoch吗？

sentences.en: Vakoch.
sentences.zh: Vakoch。

sentences.en: Vakoch.
sentences.zh: Vakoch。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: So, Doug, METI has a plan here.
sentences.zh: 那么，道格，METI在这里有一个计划。

sentences.en: What is that plan?
sentences.zh: 那个计划是什么？

sentences.en: Well, our plan is by the end of 2018 to begin transmitting powerful, intentional signals to nearby stars in the hope of getting a response.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们的计划是在2018年底之前开始向附近的恒星发送强大的、有目的的信号，希望能得到回应。

sentences.en: And so, this is an outgrowth of a search that has been going on for over half a century, a search to make contact with intelligence on other worlds.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是半个多世纪以来一直在进行的搜索的延伸，这是一项与外星智慧取得联系的搜索。

sentences.en: But until now, the focus has been almost exclusively on listening for signals.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，重点几乎完全放在了倾听信号上。

sentences.en: In 1961, Frank Drake and a group of astronomers, physicists, and biologists formed a privately funded organization called SETI, the search for extraterrestrial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 1961年，弗兰克·德雷克（Frank Drake）与一群天文学家、物理学家和生物学家成立了一个私人资助的组织，名为“搜寻地外文明计划”（SETI）。

sentences.en: Their goal was to focus massive radio telescopes towards space and listen.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是将巨大的射电望远镜对准太空，进行监听。

sentences.en: But what happens if other civilizations are doing exactly what we're doing, which is simply listening and not transmitting?
sentences.zh: 但如果其他文明也在做我们正在做的事，即仅仅是监听而不发射信号，那会怎样呢？

sentences.en: And so, this is a reflection of the maturation of the search for extraterrestrial intelligence by adding a new component which reverses the direction and has humankind taking the
sentences.zh: 因此，这反映了搜寻地外文明计划的成熟，我们增加了一个新的组成部分，扭转了方向，让全人类采取

sentences.en: initiative.
sentences.zh: 主动出击。

sentences.en: Basically, a greetings.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就是打个招呼。

sentences.en: Say, hey, we're here.
sentences.zh: 说声嘿，我们在这儿。

sentences.en: Would you like to engage in some intergalactic conversation?
sentences.zh: 你想进行一些星际对话吗？

sentences.en: Doug Vakoch, we've been able to do this very thing you were describing, which is send a message into space for decades.
sentences.zh: 道格·瓦科赫（Doug Vakoch），几十年来我们一直能够做到你所描述的这件事，即向太空发送信息。

sentences.en: So, why now?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么是现在？

sentences.en: Well, because we have a knowledge that we didn't have when the search began, which is that there are planets everywhere.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我们现在拥有了搜寻开始时所不具备的知识，那就是到处都有行星。

sentences.en: And the discovery of another possible Earth-like planet.
sentences.zh: 以及发现另一颗可能像地球一样的行星。

sentences.en: To determine that there are actually seven Earth-sized planets orbiting the nearby planet.
sentences.zh: 确定有七颗地球大小的行星围绕着附近的行星运行。

sentences.en: 500 new planets, they're all orbiting.
sentences.zh: 500颗新行星，它们都在运行中。

sentences.en: 1,030 are confirmed planets.
sentences.zh: 1030颗是已确认的行星。

sentences.en: They're called candidates.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为候选行星。

sentences.en: When the first SETI search happened in 1960, we knew of no stars that have planets around them.
sentences.zh: 1960年进行第一次SETI搜寻时，我们不知道有任何恒星周围存在行星。

sentences.en: Now, we look up at the night sky and all of those stars, virtually every star has planets around it.
sentences.zh: 现在，当我们仰望夜空时，几乎每一颗恒星周围都有行星。

sentences.en: And maybe one in five of those planetary systems has a planet at just the right distance from its star that it could support liquid water.
sentences.zh: 而且这些行星系统中，大约五分之一可能拥有一颗距离恒星位置恰到好处的行星，能够支持液态水存在。

sentences.en: So, it's the Goldilocks zone.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是“金发姑娘区”。

sentences.en: Not too hot, not too cold, just right.
sentences.zh: 不太热，不太冷，刚刚好。

sentences.en: And so, we now know of particular stars that we could target that we know to have planets.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在知道可以瞄准哪些特定的恒星，因为我们知道它们拥有行星。

sentences.en: The challenge, of course, is that you're trying to figure out a way to communicate with another form of intelligence that has evolved in a completely different solar system.
sentences.zh: 当然，挑战在于你试图找到一种方法，与在完全不同的太阳系中进化出的另一种智慧形式进行交流。

sentences.en: How do you communicate with a radically different form of intelligence?
sentences.zh: 你如何与一种截然不同的智慧形式进行交流？

sentences.en: And what are kind of the base level things you can assume that they will have in common with us that you could use to kind of create some common referent?
sentences.zh: 你可以假设它们与我们有哪些共同的基础层面，从而用来建立一些共同的参照物？

sentences.en: So, what message is Mehdi looking to send?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈赫迪（Mehdi）想要发送什么信息？

sentences.en: What are we trying to say beyond, you know, what I imagine my first draft of it would be, which is, is, hello, I come and tease.
sentences.zh: 除了我想象中的初稿，也就是“你好，我来了，请指教”之外，我们还想表达什么？

sentences.en: We're trying to think of the smallest possible message that we could send that would suggest that we're interesting and that we're worth kind of listening to.
sentences.zh: 我们试图构思出一条尽可能简短的信息，既能表明我们很有趣，又值得被倾听。

sentences.en: There have been two broad approaches to creating a message, and one is exemplified by that Arecibo message.
sentences.zh: 目前有两种主要的创建信息的方法，其中一种以阿雷西博信息（Arecibo message）为代表。

sentences.en: That was sent by the astronomer Frank Drake, sent in 1974 from the Arecibo telescope in Puerto Rico, which is at the time the largest telescope in the world.
sentences.zh: 那是天文学家弗兰克·德雷克于1974年从波多黎各的阿雷西博望远镜发送的，当时它是世界上最大的望远镜。

sentences.en: And Drake had this idea of sending just a series of pulses, basically two tones, when you translated them into audio.
sentences.zh: 德雷克有个想法，就是只发送一系列脉冲，翻译成音频后基本上就是两个音调。

sentences.en: Which attempted to be encyclopedic.
sentences.zh: 它试图做到百科全书式的内容。

sentences.en: Even though it was a brief message, it tried to sample everything.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一条简短的信息，但它试图涵盖一切。

sentences.en: So, talk a little bit about our numbering system, about chemistry, what our DNA is like, what we look like, our solar system, the technology we use.
sentences.zh: 所以，谈谈我们的数字系统、化学、我们的DNA是什么样的、我们长什么样、我们的太阳系、我们使用的技术。

sentences.en: And the problem of trying to send a message that covers everything is that it may just be a jumble and it's hard to understand anything.
sentences.zh: 试图发送一条涵盖一切的信息的问题在于，它可能只是一团乱麻，很难理解任何东西。

sentences.en: Our strategy is just the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我们的策略恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Instead of this fixation on dumping a lot of data and trying to cover everything, cover just a few things very well.
sentences.zh: 与其执着于倾倒大量数据并试图涵盖一切，不如把少数几件事做好。

sentences.en: And so, we are starting with the most basic principles of arithmetic and then using those to point to the signal itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们从最基本的算术原理开始，然后用它们来指向信号本身。

sentences.en: So, you know, that's how we learn language here on Earth.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就是我们在地球上学习语言的方式。

sentences.en: We point to things.
sentences.zh: 我们指着事物。

sentences.en: But when we're sending radio waves, we're really limited to what we can point to.
sentences.zh: 但当我们发送无线电波时，我们确实局限于我们能指出的东西。

sentences.en: So, we're pointing at the nature of the radio wave itself, that it has a certain frequency, that pulses have a certain duration.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们指向无线电波本身的性质，它具有一定的频率，脉冲具有一定的持续时间。

sentences.en: We introduce the concept of time.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了时间的概念。

sentences.en: And then once we can do that, we can talk about how we use radio signals to communicate at great distances and how we use other sorts of waves to communicate with one another, say,
sentences.zh: 一旦我们能做到这一点，我们就可以谈论我们如何使用无线电信号进行远距离通信，以及我们如何使用其他类型的波进行交流，比如，

sentences.en: through voice.
sentences.zh: 通过声音。

sentences.en: So, rather than communicating something essential about human beings, you're communicating something about the very technology we're using to communicate.
sentences.zh: 所以，你不是在交流关于人类本质的东西，而是在交流关于我们用来交流的技术本身的东西。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I wish we could just send them something in English or French or Swahili, but they're not going to understand that.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我希望我们能直接用英语、法语或斯瓦希里语给他们发送信息，但他们不会理解。

sentences.en: So, the question is, what do we and they have in common?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，我们和他们有什么共同点？

sentences.en: And we have in common the technology to communicate.
sentences.zh: 我们共同拥有的是交流的技术。

sentences.en: Potentially.
sentences.zh: 潜在地。

sentences.en: They get our signal.
sentences.zh: 他们接收到了我们的信号。

sentences.en: We know they can create a radio receiver.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们能制造无线电接收器。

sentences.en: So, what do you need to know to build a radio receiver?
sentences.zh: 那么，制造无线电接收器需要知道什么？

sentences.en: It seems like no matter where you are, you've got to be a good engineer.
sentences.zh: 看起来无论你在哪里，你都必须是一名优秀的工程师。

sentences.en: And if you don't know 2 plus 2 equals 4, you're not going to be in a very good position to create something as advanced as a radio receiver.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道2加2等于4，你就无法处于制造像无线电接收器这样先进东西的有利位置。

sentences.en: Now, Stephen, there is a very real fear here expressed by prominent engineers and prominent scientists like Elon Musk, Neil deGrasse Tyson, Stephen Hawking.
sentences.zh: 现在，斯蒂芬，这里有一个由埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）、尼尔·德格拉塞·泰森（Neil deGrasse Tyson）、斯蒂芬·霍金（Stephen Hawking）等著名工程师和科学家表达的非常真实的恐惧。

sentences.en: Stephen Hawking says, if aliens visit us here on Earth, quote, the outcome would be much as when Columbus landed in America, which didn't turn out well for the Native Americans,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·霍金说，如果外星人造访地球，引用他的话，“结果可能就像哥伦布登陆美洲一样，这对美洲原住民来说结果并不好”，

sentences.en: end of quote.
sentences.zh: 引用结束。

sentences.en: Make a note, he indicates we should stay away from them at all costs.
sentences.zh: 请注意，他指出我们应该不惜一切代价远离他们。

sentences.en: Yes, there is a very active and quite heated debate about this.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于这一点存在着非常积极且相当激烈的辩论。

sentences.en: So, the argument is, we are very young in terms of our mastery of radio technology, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，论点是，就我们对无线电技术的掌握而言，我们还非常年轻，对吧？

sentences.en: We've been tinkering with radio technology for about 100 years as a species.
sentences.zh: 作为一个物种，我们摆弄无线电技术大约只有100年。

sentences.en: And if we do make contact with another species, they will be significantly more advanced than we will have been.
sentences.zh: 如果我们确实与另一个物种取得了联系，他们将比我们先进得多。

sentences.en: And they potentially might have been tinkering with these kinds of technologies for millions of years.
sentences.zh: 他们可能已经摆弄这类技术数百万年了。

sentences.en: That means that you're talking about initiating contact with a much more advanced civilization.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你是在谈论与一个先进得多的文明发起接触。

sentences.en: And the concern that many people have is that every time in the history of Earth that one advanced civilization has made contact with a less advanced civilization in terms of the technology,
sentences.zh: 许多人担心的是，在地球历史上，每一次先进文明与技术上较落后的文明接触时，

sentences.en: it has been very bad news for the less advanced civilization.
sentences.zh: 对较落后的文明来说都是非常糟糕的消息。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, I have a grave announcement to make.
sentences.zh: 女士们，先生们，我有一个严肃的声明要宣布。

sentences.en: Incredible as it may seem,
sentences.zh: 尽管这看起来令人难以置信，

sentences.en: both the observations of science and the evidence of our eyes lead to the inescapable assumption that those strange beings who landed in the Jersey farmlands tonight are the vanguard of an invading army from the planet Mars.
sentences.zh: 科学观察和我们亲眼所见的证据都指向一个不可避免的假设：今晚降落在泽西岛农田里的那些奇怪生物，是来自火星的入侵军队的先遣队。

sentences.en: That is an incredibly impactful vision because cognitive psychologists tell us that when we are trying to interpret the risks of an unknown situation,
sentences.zh: 那是一个极具冲击力的愿景，因为认知心理学家告诉我们，当我们试图解读未知情况的风险时，

sentences.en: we rely heavily on the vivid images that come to form.
sentences.zh: 我们非常依赖那些生动的形象。

sentences.en: What could be more vivid than that?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比这更生动的呢？

sentences.en: But what you need to do is look at whether that is a reasonable assumption.
sentences.zh: 但你需要做的是看看这是否是一个合理的假设。

sentences.en: And the key issue that Hawking ignores is that the civilizations he's worried about, the ones that can travel between the stars, they could already know that we're here.
sentences.zh: 霍金忽略的关键问题是，他担心的那些文明，那些能够在恒星之间旅行的文明，可能早就知道我们在这里了。

sentences.en: So any civilization with the ability to traverse the distances between the stars can already pick up I love Lucy.
sentences.zh: 所以任何有能力穿越恒星间距离的文明，都已经能接收到《我爱露西》（I Love Lucy）了。

sentences.en: But this could be a risk.
sentences.zh: 但这可能是一种风险。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're acknowledging that it might not be, but that it could be that the community that receives this message might, a la Stephen Hawking,
sentences.zh: 听起来你承认这可能不是，但也有可能接收到这条信息的群体，正如斯蒂芬·霍金所言，

sentences.en: respond aggressively in a way that could affect all of humanity.
sentences.zh: 可能会以一种可能影响全人类的方式做出激进的回应。

sentences.en: And yet you all at METI are making a choice to take on that risk.
sentences.zh: 然而，你们METI的所有人都在选择承担这种风险。

sentences.en: So how do you grapple with that?
sentences.zh: 那么你们是如何应对这一点的呢？

sentences.en: And how do you grapple with the fact that you're making that decision in some ways on behalf of all of the rest of us?
sentences.zh: 你们又是如何应对这样一个事实的：在某种程度上，你们是在代表我们所有人做出那个决定？

sentences.en: I think it is easy for us to believe that an action has a greater risk than not taking an action.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们很容易相信，采取行动比不采取行动风险更大。

sentences.en: But we know that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: For example, there are people who will decide not to take the action of having a vaccine, and yet that exposes themselves to a disease that they could otherwise prevent.
sentences.zh: 例如，有些人决定不接种疫苗，但这使他们暴露在原本可以预防的疾病中。

sentences.en: And if everyone did it, it could have devastating effects for broader public health.
sentences.zh: 如果每个人都这样做，可能会对更广泛的公共卫生造成毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: So the key is we are all making choices either to try to make contact or not to make contact.
sentences.zh: 所以关键在于，我们都在做出选择，要么尝试接触，要么不接触。

sentences.en: And we have no basis for saying that making the initiative,
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何依据说采取主动，

sentences.en: making contact is riskier than receiving a message because we could well have offsetting benefits that we would otherwise forego.
sentences.zh: 进行接触比接收信息风险更大，因为我们很可能会获得否则就会错过的补偿性利益。

sentences.en: So by making contact, we may learn what it is that other civilizations did to make it through their technological adolescence.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过接触，我们可能会了解到其他文明是如何度过他们的技术青春期的。

sentences.en: It does ultimately get down to this question, which is not just METI.
sentences.zh: 这最终归结为这个问题，这不仅仅是METI的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a whole host of other questions that we're wrestling with now with our amazing technological progress that we've made,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们现在随着我们取得的惊人技术进步而正在努力解决的一系列其他问题，

sentences.en: whether it's things like building super intelligent computers or trying to cure death or all these other ambitious goals that you sometimes hear from,
sentences.zh: 无论是像制造超级智能计算机，还是试图治愈死亡，或者你有时听到的所有这些雄心勃勃的目标，

sentences.en: particularly from Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 特别是来自硅谷的目标。

sentences.en: These are decisions that affect us all, affect the whole planet.
sentences.zh: 这些都是影响我们所有人、影响整个地球的决定。

sentences.en: The problem is if you don't build those systems, if you don't build decisions that can wrestle with these kinds of issues,
sentences.zh: 问题是，如果你不建立那些系统，如果你不建立能够处理这些问题的决策机制，

sentences.en: then it just means that the gamblers end up always making the choice for us.
sentences.zh: 那就意味着赌徒最终总是会为我们做出选择。

sentences.en: The people who are willing to take the risk will then take the risk and we'll all be kind of stuck in the consequences of their actions.
sentences.zh: 那些愿意承担风险的人会承担风险，而我们所有人都会被困在他们行为的后果中。

sentences.en: And finally, Doug, let's say that you're wrong and that it doesn't work and the message is sent, but it kind of just ends up in the ether.
sentences.zh: 最后，道格，假设你错了，这行不通，信息发送出去了，但它最终只是消失在以太中。

sentences.en: What then?
sentences.zh: 那会怎样？

sentences.en: If we are listening hundreds or thousands of years from now for a reply to our messages and year after year after year,
sentences.zh: 如果我们几百年甚至几千年后还在倾听对我们信息的回复，年复一年，

sentences.en: all we hear is this deafening silence, I think it will tell us that humanity is incredibly rare,
sentences.zh: 我们听到的只有震耳欲聋的寂静，我想这会告诉我们，人类是极其罕见的，

sentences.en: at least insofar as a civilization who is willing to try to make contact with other intelligence in the universe.
sentences.zh: 至少就愿意尝试与宇宙中其他智慧生命接触的文明而言是这样。

sentences.en: And that in itself is inherently valuable.
sentences.zh: 而这本身就具有内在的价值。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your time, Doug.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感谢你的时间，道格。

sentences.en: Good luck on behalf of all of us.
sentences.zh: 祝我们大家好运。

sentences.en: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell unveiled a new version of the Republican health care plan on Thursday,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔（Mitch McConnell）周四公布了共和党医疗保健计划的新版本，

sentences.en: the latest attempt to win over enough senators to repeal and replace the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 这是争取足够多参议员支持以废除并取代《平价医疗法案》（Affordable Care Act）的最新尝试。

sentences.en: Unlike the previous bill, the new proposal is designed to appeal to moderate Republican senators by leaving in place the Affordable Care Act's taxes on the wealthy,
sentences.zh: 与之前的法案不同，新提案旨在通过保留《平价医疗法案》中对富人的税收来吸引温和派共和党参议员，

sentences.en: and to conservative senators by allowing insurers to offer health plans that do not comply, with ACA standards.
sentences.zh: 并通过允许保险公司提供不符合ACA标准的健康计划来吸引保守派参议员。

sentences.en: But two key senators immediately said they would not even support bringing the bill to a vote — Susan Collins of Maine and Rand Paul of Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 但两位关键参议员——缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）和肯塔基州的兰德·保罗（Rand Paul）——立即表示他们甚至不会支持将该法案付诸表决。

sentences.en: If a single additional Republican senator joins them in opposing the bill, the latest version of the legislation will die.
sentences.zh: 如果再有一名共和党参议员加入他们反对该法案，该法案的最新版本就会夭折。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom, Lindsay Garrison, Rachel Quester, and Andy Mills.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》（The Daily）由西奥·巴尔科姆（Theo Balcom）、琳赛·加里森（Lindsay Garrison）、雷切尔·奎斯特（Rachel Quester）和安迪·米尔斯（Andy Mills）制作。

sentences.en: Lisa Tobin is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·托宾（Lisa Tobin）是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Samantha Hennig is our editorial director.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格（Samantha Hennig）是我们的编辑总监。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰兹伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Martha Daniel, Michaela Bouchard, Peter Sale, Pedro Rosado, Michael Simon-Johnson, Matt Apuzo, and Matt's wife, Becky.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢玛莎·丹尼尔（Martha Daniel）、米凯拉·布沙尔（Michaela Bouchard）、彼得·塞尔（Peter Sale）、佩德罗·罗萨多（Pedro Rosado）、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊（Michael Simon-Johnson）、马特·阿普佐（Matt Apuzo）以及马特的妻子贝基（Becky）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何收听平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
